geely-e2.note: Single rear-mounted motor (Xingyuan/EX2 layout); no dual-motor version announced for Europe. Not verified on a manufacturer page (fetch budget exhausted).

volvo-ex30.note: RWD on single-motor P3/P5/P5 Long Range; AWD only on P8 AWD (ex Twin Motor Performance, 428 PS). EX30 Cross Country is sold only as P8 AWD.

zeekr-x.note: Core RWD and Long Range RWD; AWD only on Privilege AWD (dual motor, 365 kW).

volvo-xc40.note: XC40 mild hybrids (B3, B4) are FWD only in CH/DE; single-motor EX40/EC40 (P5, P5 Long Range) are RWD; AWD only on electric EX40/EC40 P8 AWD and P8 Performance AWD (Twin Motor).

lynk-co-01.note: Front-wheel drive ('Frontantrieb') only; no AWD version in Europe.

geely-e5.note: Single front motor (160 kW); no dual-motor version in Europe. Not verified on a manufacturer page (fetch budget exhausted).

volvo-v60.note: B4 mild hybrid is FWD; AWD only on the T6 AWD plug-in hybrid. V60 Cross Country is no longer available new (DE page: 'nicht mehr lieferbar'; not listed in CH).

polestar-2.note: Standard/Long Range Single Motor are RWD; AWD on Long Range Dual Motor (optionally with Performance pack).

zeekr-7-gt.note: Business Edition RWD and Long Range RWD; AWD only on Privilege AWD (dual motor, 475 kW). zeekr.eu model page could not be fetched; per Zeekr NL configurator as reported.

volvo-ex60.note: P6 is RWD; AWD on P10 AWD and P12 AWD.

volvo-xc60.note: All versions AWD: B5 AWD mild hybrid, T6 AWD and T8 AWD plug-in hybrids (motorized.ch: 'Alle Varianten des Volvo XC60 SUV verfügen über Allradantrieb'); no FWD B4 in CH/DE.

polestar-4.note: Rear Motor (single motor) is RWD; AWD on Dual Motor (400 kW).

lynk-co-08.note: Plug-in hybrid with front-wheel drive in Europe (the 4WD EM-P is China-only); the Swiss page does not state the drive type, so not confirmed on a manufacturer page.

zeekr-7x.note: Core RWD and Long Range RWD; AWD only on Privilege AWD (ex Performance, dual motor, 470 kW). Applies to the current 7X; the all-new 7X arrives Q1 2027.

geely-starray-em-i.note: EM-i plug-in hybrid drives the front wheels; no AWD version. Not verified on a manufacturer page (fetch budget exhausted).

volvo-es90.note: Single Motor Extended Range is RWD; AWD on Twin Motor and Twin Motor Performance.

polestar-5.note: AWD only: Dual Motor and Performance (both dual motor).

zeekr-001.note: Long Range RWD (single motor); AWD on Privilege AWD and Performance AWD (dual motor, 400 kW).

lotus-emeya.note: AWD only: Emeya 600 and 900 are both dual-motor (front + rear). The Swiss page names the versions but does not spell out the drive layout.

volvo-ex90.note: Single Motor (245 kW) is RWD ('Hinterradantrieb'); AWD on Twin Motor and Twin Motor Performance.

volvo-xc90.note: All versions AWD: B5 AWD mild hybrid and T8 AWD plug-in hybrid; no FWD version.

polestar-3.note: Rear Motor is RWD; AWD on Dual Motor and Performance.

zeekr-9x.note: AWD only: Ultra AWD plug-in hybrid with front + rear motors (897 hp system).

lotus-eletre.note: AWD only: Eletre 600 and 900 are dual-motor with 'Allradtraktion'; the Eletre X range-extender also drives through front and rear e-motors (its Swiss page does not state the layout).

lotus-emira.note: Mid-engined, rear-wheel drive only (V6 and 2.0 turbo four).

lotus-evija.note: Four electric motors (one per wheel), AWD only.

levc-tx.note: Range-extender electric; the e-motor drives the rear wheels. Not sold in CH. Not verified on a manufacturer page (fetch budget exhausted).

farizon-sv.note: Single front e-motor driving the front wheels, as best recalled; not verified (search and fetch budgets exhausted).

farizon-v7e.note: Could not be verified (search and fetch budgets exhausted). Single-motor 2WD with no AWD version known; rear drive assumed from the usual rear-motor layout of Chinese medium e-vans.

levc-vn5.note: Same range-extender drivetrain as the TX taxi: e-motor drives the rear wheels. Not sold in CH. Not verified on a manufacturer page.

kgm-tivoli.note: 1.5 T-GDi petrol (163 PS) in 2WD (front) or 4WD; KGM Switzerland advertises the Tivoli Steel as 'Der günstigste 4x4 der Schweiz'.

kgm-korando.note: 1.5 T-GDi petrol with 6-speed automatic: 2WD (front) standard; 'Allrad 4x4' (4WD 6AT) is a CHF 3,000 option on every trim (Steel, Blackline, Titanium).

kgm-actyon.note: KGM Switzerland advertises the 'KGM Actyon 4x4'; the 1.5 T-GDi petrol comes in 2WD and 4WD (per the site's technical table), while the Actyon Hybrid is 2WD (front) only.

kgm-torres.note: 4WD only with the 1.5 T-GDi petrol (2WD or 4WD); Torres Hybrid is 2WD only and the Torres EVX (single front motor) is FWD. Swiss model pages not fetched (budget exhausted).

kgm-rexton.note: 2.2 e-XDi diesel (202 PS) with '4WD Allradantrieb' only; the diesel row of KGM CH's technical table lists 4WD only.

kgm-musso.note: Run-out: 2.2 e-XDi diesel, 4WD only (part-time 4x4, rear-drive based); Musso Grand long-bed likewise. Still listed on KGM CH's price page (Musso from CHF 42,689, Musso Grand from CHF 44,311).

kgm-musso-ev.note: KGM Switzerland advertises the Musso EV as '4x4' (dual motor); a 2WD version with a single front motor also exists, but its Swiss availability is not confirmed.

kgm-musso-rhino.note: 2.2 e-XDi diesel with part-time 4x4 (rear-drive based); KGM CH lists Musso (MY26) from CHF 35,143 and Musso Grand (MY26) from CHF 36,998, and its diesel row shows 4WD only. A 2WD version elsewhere in Europe is not ruled out.

honda-super-n.note: Single front motor, FWD only (N-One e: based). Not sold in CH.

honda-civic.note: e:HEV, FWD only (the Type R was also FWD).

honda-zr-v.note: e:HEV, FWD only in Europe (4WD is Japan-only). Not verified on a Honda page (honda.ch fetch failed).

honda-cr-v.note: AWD only on the e:HEV full hybrid; e:PHEV plug-in hybrid is FWD only. Not verified on a Honda page (honda.ch fetch failed).

mclaren-750s.note: Mid-engined V8, RWD only (coupé and Spider).

mclaren-artura.note: V6 plug-in hybrid with the e-motor in the gearbox; RWD only (coupé and Spider).

mclaren-w1.note: V8 hybrid hypercar, RWD only (limited run).

koenigsegg-gemera.note: HV8 hybrid with Dark Matter e-motor: 'four-wheel drive and four-wheel torque vectoring' (limited run).

koenigsegg-jesko.note: Twin-turbo V8, RWD only (Attack and Absolut; limited run).

deepal-s05.note: Single rear motor (BEV), RWD only in Europe. Not sold in CH. Not verified on a manufacturer page (fetch budget exhausted).

deepal-s07.note: Single rear motor (BEV, 160 kW), RWD only in Europe. Not sold in CH. Not verified on a manufacturer page (fetch budget exhausted).
